意味（日本語）: しまい込む、人里離れた場所にある
意味（簡単な英英訳）: to store something in a safe place, to be hidden
例文: The cabin is tucked away in the forest.

意味（日本語）: 無視する、耳を貸さない
意味（簡単な英英訳）: to stop listening or paying attention
例文: I tend to tune out when he starts talking about politics.

意味（簡単な英英訳）: to improve a bad situation, to face the opposite direction
例文: The new CEO turned the company around.
The club was full, so they were turning people away.
The weather was so bad we had to turn back.
They turned down my application.
The caterpillar turned into a butterfly.

意味（日本語）: 消す、興味をなくさせる
意味（簡単な英英訳）: to switch off, to cause someone to lose interest
例文: Please turn off the TV.
Turn on the lights, it's dark in here.

意味（日本語）: 〜という結果になる、判明する
例文: It turned out to be a great party.
Turn over the page and read the next chapter.

意味（簡単な英英訳）: to appear unexpectedly, to increase volume
例文: He finally turned up two hours late.
We used up all the sugar.

意味（日本語）: 到来を告げる、導き入れる
意味（簡単な英英訳）: to mark the beginning of something new
例文: The invention of the internet ushered in a new era.

意味（簡単な英英訳）: to guarantee someone's good character or the quality of something
例文: I can vouch for her honesty.

意味（簡単な英英訳）: to stay awake waiting for someone
例文: Don't wait up for me, I'll be home late.
I wake up at 7 AM every day.
He walked out on his wife and children.

意味（簡単な英英訳）: to prevent something dangerous from affecting you
例文: She wore an amulet to ward off evil spirits.

意味（日本語）: 準備運動をする、温まる
意味（簡単な英英訳）: to prepare for exercise, to become warm
例文: You should always warm up before running.
The bridge was washed away by the flood.
Who is going to wash up tonight?
Watch out for bears in this forest.

意味（日本語）: 水で薄める、骨抜きにする
意味（簡単な英英訳）: to dilute, to make something less extreme
例文: The proposal was watered down to appease the opposition.

意味（日本語）: （悪習などから）徐々に引き離す
意味（簡単な英英訳）: to gradually stop someone from doing something
例文: I'm trying to wean myself off coffee.

意味（日本語）: 疲れさせる、すり減らす
意味（簡単な英英訳）: to exhaust someone, to reduce gradually
例文: The constant stress eventually wore him down.
The painkiller started to wear off.

意味（日本語）: すり減らす、疲れ果てさせる
意味（簡単な英英訳）: to damage through use, to exhaust
例文: These shoes are worn out. / That hike wore me out.

意味（日本語）: 意見を述べる、計量する
意味（簡単な英英訳）: to give an opinion, to be weighed before a match
例文: Everyone weighed in with their suggestions.

意味（日本語）: 手早く作る、感情をかき立てる
意味（簡単な英英訳）: to make food quickly, to excite
例文: I can whip up some pasta for dinner.

意味（日本語）: くつろぐ、徐々に終わらせる
意味（簡単な英英訳）: to relax, to gradually bring to an end
例文: I like to wind down with a good book before bed.
If you keep doing that, you'll wind up in jail.
The disease wiped out the entire village.

意味（日本語）: うまく避けて通る、対処する
意味（簡単な英英訳）: to find a way to overcome a problem
例文: We'll have to work around this issue.

意味（日本語）: 運動する、解決する、うまくいく
意味（簡単な英英訳）: to exercise, to solve, to be successful
例文: I work out at the gym twice a week.
I went for a walk to work up an appetite.
Let's wrap up this meeting.
Please write down your address here.

意味（簡単な英英訳）: to accept that something is a failure or loss
例文: The bank wrote off the bad debt.
You must yield to oncoming traffic.

意味（日本語）: 照準を合わせる、的を絞る
意味（簡単な英英訳）: to direct all attention towards something
例文: We need to zero in on the root cause of the problem.
I totally zoned out during the presentation.
Can you zoom in on the picture?
